verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's CLI/API/SDK expose full platform control (search offers, create instances, manage keys) and are explicitly positioned for automation and scripting (vast-ai-docs-2,3,29,46), including filtered searches across many GPU offers (vast-ai-gh-1, vast-ai-docs-20). However, there is no explicit documentation of native bulk operations (e.g., batch-destroy, batch-launch, or multi-instance management commands) — bulk behavior would have to be built by looping the CLI/API yourself. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch endpoints or CLI flags for acting on multiple instances/resources simultaneously, and independent evidence of users performing such bulk workflows.
